title: [Lean] Link an end-to-end proof of multiplication below n log n
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add a pointer under “Research notes and verification contributions” to [Dan Brown](https://github.com/jdb19937) and [Kenny Daniel](https://github.com/platypii)'s end-to-end Lean proof of integer multiplication below n log n on Mathlib's finite Turing machines.

The fixed finite Mathlib machine multiplies every pair of binary-encoded natural numbers in worst-case time `O(n (log n)^(1−κ))` with **κ = 127238784 / 2^46 ≈ 2^-19.0770**. The theorem includes the complete compact runtime, all-input correctness, and the actual machine-step bound. This is an asymptotic exponent bound, not a measured execution speedup.

Correctness and runtime are proved without remaining algorithmic or analytic assumptions. The theorem's transitive axiom dependencies remain exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

## Task and overlap

Documentation pointer to an external completed proof, based on upstream `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. This does not establish the selected conditional saving κ = `0.001672660197076918` or change the selected construction.

## Validation

The proof is pinned at [3e7d90a4](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/tree/3e7d90a4bf39cad3fda42d622543b05ff4cc176e): [statement and machine model](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/3e7d90a4bf39cad3fda42d622543b05ff4cc176e/IntegerMultBounds/MathlibTM2/Statement.lean), [explicit and existential theorems](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/3e7d90a4bf39cad3fda42d622543b05ff4cc176e/IntegerMultBounds/MathlibTM2/Theorem.lean), and [completed-proof axiom audit](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/3e7d90a4bf39cad3fda42d622543b05ff4cc176e/CompletedProofCheck.lean).

The pinned [PLAN.md](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/blob/3e7d90a4bf39cad3fda42d622543b05ff4cc176e/PLAN.md) records passing `CompletedProofCheck`, `AxiomAudit` (100026 declarations), and `CompactControlCheck` (552 contracts) at the exact saving `127238784 / 2^46`. The [CI run for this exact source](https://github.com/platypii/integer-mult-bounds-lean/actions/runs/39212691096) was pending when this description was updated.

Checked the README-only diff, whitespace, and agreement with the pinned theorem and audit entry point, and the rounded base-two exponent. No new Lean build or historical certificate replay was run for this documentation update.

## Credit

[Dan Brown](https://github.com/jdb19937) and [Kenny Daniel](https://github.com/platypii) are credited as the proof's coauthors. The external proof remains in its MIT-licensed repository; this PR contributes only the README pointer.

## Open next questions

Independent review of the linked theorem statement and machine/time model. The binding margin is §5 compact-layer cost. Continue the structural improvements toward the selected conditional saving κ = `0.001672660197076918` while retaining the unconditional end-to-end machine proof and the same standard axiom dependencies.
